purpose: Pre-tool audit (Phase 2): unified action-level audit dataset over exact-solver-labelled endgame positions, with cheap already-existing per-action quantities attached.

v27_leaf_env.note: Matches production v2.7 leaf (governance/PRODUCTION.yaml). v27_score per action = virtual_score_v2(child.state, mover), the mover-perspective integer point-diff estimate.

labels.clairvoyant_meaning: perfect-information minimax/alpha-beta over the KNOWN real future deck order (known_order). Clairvoyant = upper bound, NOT honest play.
labels.marginalized_meaning: expectiminimax over the unknown remaining bag (fair-information). Only K=2 has it (K>=3 marginalized is intractable without make/unmake). At K=2 marginalized == clairvoyant (1-tile bag determined).
labels.teacher_labels_note: heur@800 / heur@1600 / heur@3200 / greedy / heur_v1@200 / iter8 CHOICES are stored as agent moves, each with its EXACT solver regret (not as a separate teacher-imitation target). heur@6400 does not exist.

per_action_fields.meeple_delta_mover: mover free-meeple change (+returns on completion, -1 on placement)
per_action_fields.completion_scored: total board score increased this action (proxy for 'completed a scoring feature')
per_action_fields.v27_score: virtual_score_v2(child.state, mover) — production v2.7 leaf point-diff estimate
per_action_fields.chosen_by: list of agents whose move == this action
per_action_fields.solver_regret_clair: exact clairvoyant regret (points lost vs optimal) — NON-NULL ONLY for actions some agent chose
per_action_fields.solver_regret_marg: exact marginalized regret — NON-NULL ONLY for actions some agent chose, K=2 only

known_caveats: PER-ACTION SOLVER REGRET IS SPARSE: the committed solver runs persisted regret only for the agents' chosen moves (+ difficulty summaries), NOT a full per-legal-action regret map. So solver_regret_* is non-null only on chosen actions. Scoring an ARBITRARY new selector's exact regret requires re-solving (cheap for K=2: median 7.5s/pos; expensive for K=3: median 264s/pos; K=4 not re-solvable). Phase 3 handles this with a K=2 re-solve that dumps the full child-value map.

CLAIRVOYANT != honest play. All K=3/K=4 labels are clairvoyant (perfect future-deck knowledge). Only K=2 has fair-information (marginalized) labels, and there they coincide with clairvoyant. See FAIR_INFORMATION_LABELS_NOTE.md.

completion_scored is a SCORE-DELTA PROXY (true for completions that score points this turn; farms never score mid-game, so farm-related completions are not flagged). It is a first-pass flag, not a verified completion detector.
K=4 lacks heur@1600 and heur_v1@200 (only iter8/heur@800/heur@3200/greedy were run there).

K=4 source buckets are CONFOUNDED with difficulty (iter8-generated endgames are objectively easier; greedy/hybrid sharper) — keep same-source paired conclusions distinct from cross-source comparisons (LEVEL2_K4_PROBE_VERDICT.md).
iter8 policy prior / visit counts / value head are NOT included (not persisted; would need a net re-run via the orchestrator). Only iter8's CHOSEN move + its exact regret are available.

The separate value_ranking dataset (value_ranking/, 20670 rows / 1494 groups, iter8 ckpt) is TEACHER-labelled (heur MCTS oracle @ oracle_sims=400), NOT solver-exact, and in a different (npz tensor) format — it is referenced, not merged here. Its verdict: value_ranking/VALUE_RANKING_VERDICT.md.
